content: Our official scores (column Ens Test in Table TABREF19 ) have placed us second (EI-Reg, EI-Oc), fourth (V-Reg) and fifth (V-Oc) on the SemEval AIT-2018 leaderboard. However, it is evident that the results obtained on the test set are not always in line with those achieved on the development set. Especially on the anger subtask for both EI-Reg and EI-Oc, the scores are considerably lower on the test set in comparison with the results on the development set. Therefore, a small error analysis was performed on the instances where our final model made the largest errors.
